baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form II active plural mukadhdhibina in the focus ayah names agents who perform takdhib.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root branch makes the offense relational: these people do not merely utter falsehood but assign falsehood to a claim or bearer. The lamed recipient construction directs woe toward the makers of that counter-verdict.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or person false is the literal branch image and makes the focus plural an active class of discreditors.

changed_reading.before: A generic class of liars receives woe.
changed_reading.after: The line targets agents who actively pronounce a claim or its bearer false; their offense is an adversarial verdict, not merely personal untruthfulness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Mukadhdhibina carries the root whose inventory includes whether a charge proves true by being carried through or false by failing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage denial as a performance exposed under trial. 'That day' is then not only when a false proposition is corrected, but when the deniers' own charge fails to hold up or complete what it claimed.

activation_trace.role: A charge proves true by being carried through and false by failing; this supplies a performance test for the deniers' stance.

changed_reading.before: The noun concerns incorrect speech alone.
changed_reading.after: The noun can also mark a stance that fails to prove true in action: its bearers do not carry their counter-charge through the test announced by 'that day.'

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's B006 branch depicts milk disappearing instead of lasting as expected.
baseline_models.mechanism: This material branch shifts falsehood from static mismatch to failed duration. The temporal phrase 'that day' can mark the point when an assumption that seemed sustaining no longer continues.

activation_trace.role: Milk failing to persist despite expectation supplies a concrete image for a denial-dependent assurance that runs out.

changed_reading.before: Their falsehood is only a mismatch between words and facts.
changed_reading.after: Their denial can be heard as reliance on an expected continuance that will fail to last, with 'that day' exposing the failed duration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deniers issue a counter-verdict against an announced warning, but the packet moves that warning from threatened speech into fixed occurrence and then into a judgment that separates truth from falsehood. The focus woe therefore announces reversal of jurisdiction: those who declared the message false are themselves overruled by the event.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the deniers' active act of declaring the warning false, functioning as a counter-verdict.
A threat specifically announces coming harm and supplies the adverse claim that the deniers contest.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the warning from disputable report into established occurrence.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the forum in which the deniers' counter-verdict is reversed.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts that what is threatened will occur before 77:13-14 names the Day of Separation.
The first refrain at 77:15 follows this occurrence-and-judgment frame, and later refrains inherit it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, fixed occurrence, and truth-separating judgment; I supply the arrow that occurrence overrules the deniers' earlier act of declaring false. A live alternative is that these cues only intensify threat without staging a reversal of verdicts.

changed_reading.before: Mukadhdhibina are people holding a false opinion about a future warning.
changed_reading.after: They are rival verdict-makers whose declaration is reversed when the warned event becomes fixed and separates truth from falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical refrain repeatedly follows a different evidentiary panel. Through the charge-success-or-failure branch, each recurrence acts like another result in an iterated test: cosmic change, historical succession, measured creation, confinement, judgment, and reward all put the deniers' stance through a new trial. At 77:47 the line carries cumulative rather than isolated force.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the image of a charge tested by whether it carries through.
The first contextual refrain begins the repeated testing cadence after the opening judgment frame.
The direct reference to what they kept declaring false identifies the recurring refrain with a sustained adversarial act.

structural_cues: The exact focus sentence recurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49.
The recurrences punctuate changing demonstrations rather than remaining inside one subject block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition after successive panels; I infer that repetition accumulates failed tests and that 77:47 retains prior results. The main alternative is that each refrain resets the cadence instead of carrying cumulative evidentiary force.

changed_reading.after: 77:47 is a cumulative checkpoint declaring that the deniers' charge has failed across multiple independent trials.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation unit presents measured making, timed governance, and containment as operations already enacted on the audience and their world. These material operations become the proving ground for the focus branch of a charge that succeeds or fails: takdhib is not only refusal of remote news but a counterclaim that fails against processes bearing and enclosing the deniers themselves.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch turns the deniers' stance into a charge whose truth must survive concrete testing.
Measuring and proportioning supplies a concrete operation embedded in the audience's own formation.
Governance by considered measure makes creation an ordered process rather than an unsupported assertion.
Gathering and holding within a container gives the earth unit a material enclosing function.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from a rhetorical question about origin through secure placement to measured timing.
77:25-28 expands containment from the womb-scale sequence to earth holding living and dead, then closes with the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured origin, governance, and containment; I infer that these operations serve as tests against which the deniers' charge fails. An alternative is that they are separate signs and not a single material verification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject only a verbally announced future.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is a failed counterclaim against measured and containing processes already operating on their own bodies and world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby contrast organizes outcomes around deliberate action, matching recompense, and wrongdoing. Because the focus branch explicitly includes falsehood in action as well as speech, takdhib enters that economy as practiced conduct: a repeated way of acting that receives a corresponding return, not an inert cognitive mistake.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth in speech or action authorizes reading denial as conduct with practical effects.
Deliberate action supplies the accountable conduct to which the positive outcome is attached.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal mechanism linking conduct and outcome.
Wrongdoing and offense classify the contrasting group immediately before the focus refrain.

structural_cues: 77:43 grounds pleasant consumption in what the addressees used to do, and 77:44 states corresponding recompense.
77:46 names the opposite addressees offenders immediately before 77:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intentional work, act-for-act recompense, and criminal classification; I infer that the focus takdhib is one such enacted practice entering reciprocal judgment. A live alternative is that disbelief and conduct remain parallel classifications rather than one causal practice.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is a mistaken proposition held in the mind.
changed_reading.after: Takdhib is practiced conduct within an act-and-return economy, so the focus woe answers an enacted pattern rather than mere error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command immediately before the focus grants enjoyment while simultaneously limiting it to little. That built-in expiry activates the focus root's image of milk expected to continue but disappearing: the deniers' sustaining benefit is real enough to enjoy, yet false as a guarantee of duration.

activation_trace.role: Milk that does not last as expected supplies the focus image of apparent sustenance failing in duration.
Keeping something available for extended enjoyment supplies the duration that the verse immediately constrains.
Littleness and paucity impose the limit that makes the enjoyed provision expire.

structural_cues: 77:46 is immediately adjacent to the focus and combines an imperative to enjoy with the limiter 'a little.'
Its command contrasts with the unqualified pleasant eating and drinking of 77:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyment plus explicit littleness; I infer that the deniers' stance is underwritten by expecting present benefit to continue and that expiry exposes that expectation. The alternative is a simple period of respite unrelated to what they believe will endure.

changed_reading.before: The nonlasting branch is an isolated lexical curiosity.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a temporal reading of the focus: present enjoyment sustains denial only briefly, and woe begins where its implied promise of continuance fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus line is immediately followed by a spoken summons and a repeated bodily refusal to bend. The packet thus gives the active takdhib a visible motor form: assigning falsehood to the message is enacted as keeping the head and posture from lowering, converting denial from proposition alone into resistant embodiment.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in both speech and action lets the focus category extend from verbal rejection into enacted refusal.
Uttered speech supplies the audible summons against which the response can be observed.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the physical act explicitly commanded and withheld.
Humility and self-lowering give the refused posture its social and affective force.

structural_cues: The focus refrain at 77:47 and its repetition at 77:49 bracket the refusal scene of 77:48.
77:48 repeats the same r-k-ayn root in command and negated response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spoken command, bodily lowering, refusal, and a refrain on each side; I infer that the refusal concretizes the focus takdhib. An alternative is that refusal to bow is merely a neighboring consequence of disbelief rather than its enacted form.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject a statement internally or verbally.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is bodily legible as refusal to lower themselves when the summons is voiced, and the two refrains enclose that enacted definition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final question sets a sequence from renewed report, through 'after it,' to heart-settling assent. Read backward into 77:47, active takdhib is the blockage in that transfer: the addressees keep assigning falsehood to the discourse and therefore never let its report become trusted inward security.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies active rejection of a report as false, the blocking operation in the sequence.
Speech renewed as report supplies the communicative material that could be received or rejected.
Temporal after-ness closes the sequence by asking what discourse could follow this one.
Assent in which the heart finds rest supplies the unrealized receiving endpoint of the report.

structural_cues: 77:50 is the surah's final ayah and follows the last contextual recurrence of the refrain at 77:49.
Its question explicitly joins a discourse, sequential finality, and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, after-ness, and heart-settling assent; I infer that takdhib blocks movement from report to trust. The alternative is that the final question merely contrasts two labels, denial and belief, without describing a reception process.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only an incorrect answer to a proposition.
changed_reading.after: Denial is an active failure of reception that prevents repeated report from becoming settled trust, even when no later discourse remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wild-animal run-and-stop branch rather than the ordinary falsehood branch. It remains anchored in the focus inventory and is sharpened by the packet's explicit removal of speech, permission, and excuse; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy for denial's finite trajectory, not as a lexical gloss of mukadhdhibina.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus B007 depicts an animal running a stage and then stopping to look behind, while the focus plural names the agents whose repeated denial has been moving through the surah.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping supplies the unusual kinetic image for a denial that advances only until judgment arrests it.
Speech itself is the literal capacity negated on the day, supplying the first arrest of the deniers' discourse.
Permission is withheld, closing any authorized continuation of their speech.
Excuse is the defensive speech-act they cannot reach after their discourse is stopped.

changed_reading.before: The deniers can indefinitely continue the verbal motion of rejecting and explaining away.
changed_reading.after: Their denial has a finite run: judgment stops its speech, bars permission, and leaves it looking back without an available excuse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps the deceptive-cloth branch onto a failed shade. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in focus B009 and in a context where something named shade neither shades nor suffices; downstream prose should say denial behaves like false cover, not claim that mukadhdhibina literally means shelter-makers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus B009 names patterned cloth whose condition gives a deceptive appearance, offering a material model of something that lies by how it looks.

activation_trace.role: A cloth that deceives by its appearance supplies the focus-root image of false presentation without spoken assertion.
Shade literally promises cover, while the following negation exposes this instance as cover in name or appearance only.
Sufficiency is explicitly denied, proving that the apparent cover cannot perform the protection its appearance suggests.

changed_reading.before: The deniers only apply a false verbal label to the message.
changed_reading.after: Their denial can also be modeled as false cover: an appearance that offers shelter from the warning while failing to shield from what tests it.

strongest_changes: Threat becoming fixed occurrence and truth-separating judgment turns the deniers into rival verdict-makers whose ruling is reversed.
The repeated refrain makes 77:47 a cumulative truth-test rather than an isolated curse formula.
The 77:47-49 refrain bracket makes denial bodily visible as refusal to lower oneself when addressed.
The 'enjoy a little' adjacency activates falsehood as failed duration: present benefit cannot guarantee continuance.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet lets one invariant line acquire changing mechanisms from each surrounding panel. The strongest gain was not a single disambiguation but coexistence: judicial counter-verdict, failed performance, material counterevidence, accountable conduct, expiring sustenance, embodied refusal, and blocked trust all remain anchored in mukadhdhibina.
remaining_uncertainties: The failed-charge and nonlasting-material branches are visibly anchored but remain more form-distant than the ordinary act of declaring false.
It is uncertain whether refrain recurrence accumulates prior tests or primarily resets the surah's rhythm after each panel.
The following bowing and belief ayat may concretize the focus category, or may name adjacent consequences rather than define it.
